description: This donut chart, titled "Win rate (%)", visually compares the win rates of three models—LLaMA, GPT-4o, and another GPT-4o entry—using concentric rings. The chart contains three distinct slices: the largest, outermost slice is a dark blue color representing GPT-4o with a win rate of 98.4%; the middle ring is a dark red slice labeled GPT-4o with a win rate of 96.8%; and the smallest, innermost slice is a light blue color representing LLaMA with a win rate of 3.2%. The chart includes a legend-like labeling system with lines connecting each label to its corresponding slice, and all percentage values are explicitly annotated next to their respective model names. The slices are arranged in descending order of size from outer to inner ring, with the smallest slice (LLaMA) visually offset or exploded slightly from the rest.
